issues.description: The UML and problem description specify Farm.animals as a private attribute with associated getter and setter (UML shows '-' visibility and the text explicitly asks for a getter and setter). However, the provided solution declares the field as public (public List<Animal> animals;), which contradicts the intended encapsulation and the UML. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected visibility and encapsulation (they are instructed to implement getter/setter and may expect the field to be private).
issues.suggestedFix: Change the Farm.animals field in the solution (and ensure the template example/instructions reflect this) to be private to match the UML and problem text. For example: private List<Animal> animals; Retain the existing public getAnimals() and setAnimals(...) methods so students implement/use proper encapsulation as intended.
